title: Desk Guidance: Listing Quality Reviews in HostCover Pet-Damage Settlements
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) pet damage and listing condition.** The pet condition share follows the outcome of the most recent quality review recorded on the listing the plan covers: a most recent review ending in a suspension settles the pet damage at 75 percent, one ending in a warning at 90 percent, and any other outcome, or no review, in full. For the pet condition share, a quality review rates the guest reviews of the year before it, so the most recent review reflects the condition guests reported over the months around the stay. The percentage applies to the pet-damage loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

## Guidance

- The quality reviews (quality assessments) are those Listings records against the listing the HostCover plan covers.
- Only the most recent review counts. An earlier suspension followed by a later pass leaves the pet damage settled in full.
- Outcomes other than a suspension or a warning, such as a pass or not assessed, and a listing with no quality review on record, leave the pet damage settled in full.

## Cases (hypothetical listings; pet-damage loss being settled 1200.00)

| Most recent quality review on the listing | Settled at | Amount entering the settlement |
|---|---|---|
| suspension | 75 percent | 900.00 |
| warning | 90 percent | 1080.00 |
| pass | in full | 1200.00 |
| none on record | in full | 1200.00 |
